notes: One typescript sheet. The handwritten own page number is - 4 -; archive number 68 is recorded only in a comment. There is no date or signature. The heading is Commentaires Appendice. One correction concerning p.37 precedes the heading; fourteen paragraphs follow it, including the continuation beginning Donner aussi. The comments request proof details for 7.4, identification of K with a raised point in 7.1, a reference for the displayed-in-prose regularity implication, an argument on p.6, naming of vertical arrows, references for Gr and compatibility with filtrations, a parallel diagram, and clarification about adding connexe plus a proof reference. The author explicitly asks questions; none is answered by this transcription. The page contains inline mathematics but no mathematical display, commutative diagram, or substantive drawing. The only graphical reproductions added are two sets of detached marks whose authored status is uncertain. Handwriting is present in the page number and in three quotation pairs and an implication arrow on p.5; no named hand is established from this packet. Two typewriter overtypes survive: a/e in the p.9 de and d/e in the final de. H is description-only throughout and is treated as unavailable for collation: every h_reading is null and every diff_h is false. No H page wrapper or description omission is counted as a manuscript difference. The previously supplied notation table was consulted as observations only; the present Z and Q were read from this page’s strokes.
math_reading_decisions: K and both Gr expressions have filled raised points; the page does not supply a degree value. The transcription preserves a bullet without supplying a degree or changing it to a prime.

The handwritten regularity arrow points right and has a doubled shaft. The fibre indices are independently read as t and s. The uncertain quotation pair is kept rather than balanced by mathematical expectation.
The p.7 equality is X = S and the final object is an ordinary underlined Z. The separate low line is not silently converted to a double-struck alphabet.

The lower coefficient in the requested analogous diagram is a single ordinary Q with an underline. The inner lower curl is part of the Q tail. No field interpretation is used to force a blackboard-bold letter.
The words request a diagram, but no diagram is actually drawn on this sheet; none is invented. The exact references (7.10.2 bis), (cf. 3.3), and (7.10.1 bis) are preserved.
The detached point and the pair under Gr receive graphical records with uncertainty and no mathematical role. Their presence is not used to add a suffix, colon, or relation.
These are readings of notation and requests, not mathematical proof checks. No regularity implication, compatibility statement, or generalization claim was proved or externally verified.
